calculate_elastic_tensor: run calculate_elasticity to compute the elastic tensor, bulk modulus, and shear modulus for an ASE Atoms structure
calculate_bulk_modulus: run calculate_elasticity with an ASE Atoms object and calculator to get the bulk modulus VRH value
calculate_shear_modulus: run calculate_elasticity with an ASE Atoms object and calculator to get the shear modulus VRH value
calculate_elasticity_with_custom_strains: run calculate_elasticity with custom norm_strains and shear_strains sequences to control deformation magnitudes
calculate_elasticity_without_relaxation: run calculate_elasticity with relax_initial and relax_strained set to False to skip all relaxation steps
